# nico_ip_block (Resource)

IP Block is a contiguous block of IP addresses defined by a prefix and prefix length.

## Example Usage

```terraform
resource "nico_ip_block" "example" {
  site_id                        = "site-id-uuid"
  name                           = "name-value"
  routing_type                   = "routing-type-value"
  prefix                         = "prefix-value"
  prefix_length                  = 0
  protocol_version               = "protocol-version-value"
  description                    = "description-value"
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `name` (String) Name of the IP Block
- `prefix` (String) Either IPv4 or IPv6 address
- `prefix_length` (Number) Min: 1, Max: 32 for IPv4, 128 for IPv6
- `protocol_version` (String) Version of the ip network ipv4 or ipv6
- `routing_type` (String) Routing type of the IP Block

### Optional

- `description` (String) Description of the IP Block
- `ip_block_id` (String) Path parameter: ip_block_id.
- `site_id` (String) ID of the site

### Read-Only

- `created` (String) Date/time when the Ip Block was created
- `id` (String) The resource ID.
- `infrastructure_provider_id` (String) ID of the Infrastructure Provider
- `status` (String) Status of the IP Block
- `status_history` (Attributes List) Chronological status history for the IP Block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--status_history))
- `tenant_id` (String) ID of the Tenant
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the Ip Block was last updated
- `usage_stats` (Attributes) Usage summary from IPAM for the IP Block (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--usage_stats))

<a id="nestedatt--status_history"></a>
### Nested Schema for `status_history`

Read-Only:

- `created` (String) Date/time when the associated entity assumed the status
- `message` (String) Description of the state and cause/remedy in case of error
- `status` (String) State of the associated entity at a particular time
- `updated` (String) Date/time when the associated entity was last observed with this status


<a id="nestedatt--usage_stats"></a>
### Nested Schema for `usage_stats`

Read-Only:

- `acquired_i_ps` (Number) Number of individual IP addresses acquired from the block
- `acquired_prefixes` (Number) Total number of prefixes (of any size) acquired from this block
- `available_i_ps` (Number) Total number of IP addresses in the block (acquired and unused), capped at 2,147,483,647. An IP Block allocated to one child prefix of the same size reports zero.
- `available_prefixes` (List of String) Example prefixes available to acquire
- `available_smallest_prefixes` (Number) Number of complete `/30` IPv4 prefixes or `/126` IPv6 prefixes remaining after acquired child prefixes are excluded. Both prefix sizes contain four addresses. The count is capped at 2,147,483,647. The `acquiredIPs` count is not subtracted.
